svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt $0 mark, v3
svg.desc: The chosen Mint Tilt family keeps a gentle eight-degree angle, now with a proper Arial Bold $0. Its connected sage local base remains upright and centered. The lower pointer is aligned and attached, with a circular opening to signal local discovery. Original, unadopted logo concept; lettering is editable.
